theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_regular_of_const_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (p : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T U → BoundaryVanishes T → p ∈ T.support → 0 < δ → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p δ → HasMassDensity T y k) → p ∈ regularSet T
